title: समकालीन विमर्श के विभिन्न आयाम
nepali: यह सदी विमर्शों की सदी है । यानि समाज की किसी भी समस्या पर चर्चा–परिचर्चा, संवाद, तर्क–वितर्क आदि । दूसरे शब्दों में कहा जाये तो जब व्यक्ति किसी समूह में किसी विषय पर चिन्तन अथचा चर्चा–परिचर्चा करता है तो उसे विमर्श कहा जाता है या जब कोई व्यक्ति किसी विषय को लेकर अकेले में गहन, चिन्तन, मनन करके किसी समूह में जाकर उस विषय पर अन्य व्यक्तियों से तर्क–वितर्क करता है तो उसे विमर्श कहते हैं ।संस्कृत, हिन्दी तथा अंग्रेजी शब्दकोशों में बहुत से विद्वानों द्वारा विमर्श शब्द को परिभाषित किया गया है । डॉ भोलानाथ के अनुसार विमर्श का अर्थ है–‘‘तबादला–ए–खयाल, परामर्श, मशविरा, राय–बात, विचार विनिमय, विचार विमर्श, सोच विचार।’’ ज्ञान शब्दकोश में विमर्श का तात्पर्य ‘विचार, विवेचन, परीक्षण, समीक्षा, तर्क, ज्ञान।’ आदि के रूप में अंकित किया गया है । मानक हिन्दी कोश में विमर्श का अर्थ इस प्रकार है –‘सोच विचार कर तथ्य या वास्तविकता का पता लगाना । किसी बात या विषय पर कुछ सोचना समझना । विचार करना । गुण–दोष आदि की आलोचना या मीमांसा करना (डेलिबरेशन)। जाँचना और परखना । किसी से परामर्श या सलाह करना आदि ।आज समाज का हर वह तबका जो अधिकारों से वंचित है उसने अपने हक, अधिकार और अपनी अस्मितागत पहचान के लिए निर्णायक लड़ाई छेड़ रखी है । ध्यान देने की बात यह है कि यह लड़ाई किसी के विरूद्ध नही, बल्कि अपने या अपने समुदाय के पक्ष में लड़ी जा रही है । इन लड़ाइयों के पीछे एक सुविचारित दर्शन कार्य कर रहा है । हिंदी साहित्य में समाज के ज्वलंत विषयों को कहानी, कविता, उपन्यास, आत्मकथा और अन्य विधाओं के माध्यम से समाज का ध्यान अपनी ओर खींचा जा रहा है । शोषित समाज के हक के लिए लेखन कार्य किया जा रहा है । विमर्श साहित्य वर्तमान समय में लगभग सभी विश्वविद्यालयों के हिंदी या अन्य भाषाओं के पाठ्यक्रम का हिस्सा है । प्रस्तुत आलेख में साहित्यिक विमर्श के आयामों पर चर्चा की गई है ।
american_english: This century is the century of discourses. That is, discussion and debate, dialogue, argument and counter-argument and so on about any problem of society. Put in other words, when a person carries out reflection or discussion and debate on a subject within some group, that is called discourse, or when a person, having thought deeply and reflected on a subject alone, goes into a group and argues and counter-argues that subject with other persons, that is called discourse. Many scholars have defined the word discourse in Sanskrit, Hindi and English dictionaries. According to Dr. Bholanath, the meaning of discourse is — "exchange of ideas, consultation, counsel, exchange of views, exchange of thoughts, deliberation, reflection." In the Gyan dictionary, the purport of discourse is recorded as 'thought, discussion, examination, review, argument, knowledge,' and so on. In the Standard Hindi Dictionary the meaning of discourse is as follows — 'ascertaining a fact or a reality by thinking it over. Thinking and understanding something about some matter or subject. Deliberating. Criticizing or examining the merits and demerits and so on (deliberation). Examining and testing. Consulting or taking advice from someone, and so on. Today every section of society that is deprived of rights has launched a decisive struggle for its due, its rights and its identity-based recognition. It is worth noting that this struggle is not being waged against anyone, but rather in favor of oneself or one's own community. Behind these struggles a well-considered philosophy is at work. In Hindi literature, the attention of society is being drawn toward itself through the pressing issues of society by means of the story, the poem, the novel, the autobiography and other genres. Writing is being done for the sake of the rights of the oppressed society. In the present time, discourse literature is a part of the Hindi or other language curricula of nearly all universities. In the present article, the dimensions of literary discourse have been discussed.

Checking and testing. Consulting or getting advice from someone, and so on. In other words, when someone in some group mulls over a subject or hashes it out with them, that's discourse; or when someone thinks a subject over deeply all alone and then rocks up to a group and argues it out with everyone there, that's discourse too. Lots of scholars have defined the word discourse in Sanskrit, Hindi and English dictionaries. Dr Bholanath says discourse means — "exchange of ideas, consultation, counsel, exchange of views, exchange of thoughts, deliberation, reflection." The Gyan dictionary puts the meaning of discourse down as 'thought, discussion, examination, review, argument, knowledge' and the like. The Standard Hindi Dictionary gives the meaning of discourse like this — 'figuring out a fact or a reality by thinking it over. Thinking a matter or subject through and getting your head around it. Deliberating. Criticizing or picking apart the good and bad points and so on (deliberation). Testing and checking it out. Consulting or getting advice off someone, and so on. Today every bunch in society that's been kept from its rights has jumped into a decisive fight for what it's owed, for its rights and for its own identity. Worth a mention: this fight isn't against anybody, it's on the side of yourself and your own community. Behind these fights there's some well-thought-out philosophy doing the work. In Hindi literature, society's attention is getting pulled in by way of the story, poem, novel, autobiography and other genres, using society's hot-button issues. People are writing for the sake of the rights of the oppressed. These days, discourse literature is part of the Hindi or other language course at pretty much every university. This article talks through the dimensions of literary discourse.
